explanation: ComfyUI manifests must require only the current version.
Retired ComfyUI output-node compatibility must not spread.
The current ComfyUI workflow contract must not reintroduce retired semantic-role, top-level-default, binding-valueType, or image-list wire fields.
The canonical ComfyUI user-config V1 contract uses only dotted-classification defaultWorkflows mappings and must not reintroduce the retired singular default alias.
Editor metadata must not retain V1 migration code.
Browser-local state must not migrate the retired root workbench shape.
Retired authoring export identity must not be read or stripped.
Authoring Shader outputs must have one object representation.
Runtime Shader outputs and roles must not accept alternate wire types.
Compiled and preview image sampling must be explicit.
ComfyUI verification cache keys must always include the current ComfyUI version.
ComfyUI workflow sources must use the shared user source rather than the retired Electron/editor source identity.
Resource aliases must use only the current wrapped object-entry manifest.
Current-only source contracts must use stable schema or format identities without embedding the numeric version in the marker.
Current-only source APIs must not encode the current version in type, schema, document, state, manifest, protocol, or project symbol names.
